description: This file defines the RequestInterface, an interface representing an outgoing HTTP client request in a PSR-7 implementation. It includes method signatures for retrieving and setting the request target, HTTP method, and URI, emphasizing immutability and compliance with HTTP standards.

methods.name: getRequestTarget
methods.description: Retrieves the request target (e.g., path and query).

methods.name: withRequestTarget
methods.description: Returns a new instance with the specified request target, supporting immutable object pattern.

methods.name: getMethod
methods.description: Retrieves the HTTP method (e.g., GET, POST).

methods.name: withMethod
methods.description: Returns a new instance with the specified HTTP method, following immutability standards.

methods.name: getUri
methods.description: Retrieves the URI object associated with the request.

methods.name: withUri
methods.description: Returns a new instance with the specified URI, optionally preserving the Host header.
